originality.rationale: Accessible original published research on quantum complete intersections, unrestricted algebra automorphisms, and bi-Frobenius permutation antipodes was compared at the level of objects and implication. The new claim enumerates all field-linear square-one algebra anti-automorphisms for all four parameter/characteristic cases, their fixed-space spectra, and reduced component geometry. Inspected primary studies address Hochschild invariants or additional coalgebra structures rather than this unrestricted classification; previous automorphism calculations or free cube-zero anti-involutions are not equivalent. An unlocated general treatment remains a publication-priority risk.

value.rationale: A complete natural involution invariant for a standard noncommutative local-algebra family: all fields and nonzero parameters; exact numbers, fixed-space distributions, and distinct reduced-geometric regimes (1,5,3,1 components). Characteristic-two coalescence of three odd-characteristic exterior components to one nontrivial irreducible variety is a structural rather than purely numerical result.
